passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Tell the Israelites, ‘Any Israelite or foreigner living in Israel who gives any of his children to Molech must be put to death. The people of the land are to stone him.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a message for the Israelites.
The LORD said, “Tell the Israelites this command.
Any Israelite who gives any of his children to Molech must be put to death.
Any foreigner living in Israel who gives any of his children to Molech must be put to death.
The people of the land must stone that person.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ וְאֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל תֹּאמַר֒ אִ֣ישׁ אִישׁ֩ מִבְּנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּמִן־ הַגֵּ֣ר׀ הַגָּ֣ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֧ן מִזַּרְע֛וֹ לַמֹּ֖לֶךְ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑ת עַ֥ם הָאָ֖רֶץ יִרְגְּמֻ֥הוּ בָאָֽבֶן׃

passages.text: And I will set My face against that man and cut him off from his people, because by giving his offspring to Molech, he has defiled My sanctuary and profaned My holy name.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God speaks to Moses and the Israelites.
God warns about a specific sin.
A man gives his child to Molech.
Molech is a false god.
God will turn against that man.
God will remove that man from his people.
The man defiles God's sanctuary.
The man profanes God's holy name.
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֞י אֶתֵּ֤ן אֶת־ פָּנַי֙ בָּאִ֣ישׁ הַה֔וּא וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י אֹת֖וֹ מִקֶּ֣רֶב עַמּ֑וֹ כִּ֤י מִזַּרְעוֹ֙ נָתַ֣ן לַמֹּ֔לֶךְ לְמַ֗עַן טַמֵּא֙ אֶת־ מִקְדָּשִׁ֔י וּלְחַלֵּ֖ל אֶת־ שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: And if the people of the land ever hide their eyes and fail to put to death the man who gives one of his children to Molech, then I will set My face against that man and his family and cut off from among their people both him and all who follow him in prostituting themselves with Molech.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave a command to the Israelites.
God also included foreigners living in Israel.
God said, “If anyone gives his child to Molech, he must be put to death.”
If the people of the land see a man give his child to Molech, they must not ignore it.
If the people hide their eyes and do not put him to death, I, the LORD, will act.
I will turn My face against that man.
I will also turn My face against his family.
I will cut off that man from his people.
I will also cut off all who follow him.
These people have prostituted themselves by following Molech.
I will remove them from among their people.
passages.original: וְאִ֡ם הַעְלֵ֣ם יַעְלִימֽוּ֩ עַ֨ם הָאָ֜רֶץ אֶת־ עֵֽינֵיהֶם֙ מִן־ הָאִ֣ישׁ הַה֔וּא בְּתִתּ֥וֹ מִזַּרְע֖וֹ לַמֹּ֑לֶךְ לְבִלְתִּ֖י הָמִ֥ית אֹתֽוֹ׃ וְשַׂמְתִּ֨י אֲנִ֧י אֶת־ פָּנַ֛י בָּאִ֥ישׁ הַה֖וּא וּבְמִשְׁפַּחְתּ֑וֹ וְהִכְרַתִּ֨י אֹת֜וֹ וְאֵ֣ת׀ כָּל־ הַזֹּנִ֣ים אַחֲרָ֗יו לִזְנ֛וֹת אַחֲרֵ֥י הַמֹּ֖לֶךְ מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽם׃

passages.text: Whoever turns to mediums or spiritists to prostitute himself with them, I will also set My face against that person and cut him off from his people.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God speaks to His people.
A person may turn to mediums or spiritists.
Mediums and spiritists claim to contact the dead or spirits.
If a person seeks them out, he acts unfaithfully toward God.
God will set His face against that person.
God will oppose that person.
God will cut that person off from his people.
God will remove him from the community.
passages.original: וְהַנֶּ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּפְנֶ֤ה אֶל־ הָֽאֹבֹת֙ וְאֶל־ הַיִּדְּעֹנִ֔ים לִזְנ֖וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־ פָּנַי֙ בַּנֶּ֣פֶשׁ הַהִ֔וא וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י אֹת֖וֹ מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Consecrate yourselves, therefore, and be holy, because I am the LORD your God.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God commands them to consecrate themselves.
God tells them to be holy.
God says, “I am the LORD your God.”
passages.original: וְהִ֨תְקַדִּשְׁתֶּ֔ם וִהְיִיתֶ֖ם קְדֹשִׁ֑ים כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: And you shall keep My statutes and practice them. I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God gives laws and commands.
God says, “Keep My statutes.”
God says, “Do what I command.”
God says, “I am the LORD.”
God says, “I make you holy.”
passages.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ חֻקֹּתַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃

passages.text: If anyone curses his father or mother, he must be put to death. He has cursed his father or mother; his blood shall be upon him.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel.
God is the LORD, their God.
God commands respect for parents.
If any person curses his father or his mother, he must die.
He has cursed his father or his mother.
He is responsible for his own death.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אִ֣ישׁ אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְקַלֵּ֧ל אֶת־ אָבִ֛יו וְאֶת־ אִמּ֖וֹ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑ת אָבִ֧יו וְאִמּ֛וֹ קִלֵּ֖ל דָּמָ֥יו בּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: If a man commits adultery with another man’s wife—with the wife of his neighbor—both the adulterer and the adulteress must surely be put to death.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel.
God is holy.
God commanded the people to be holy.
God said, “You must keep My statutes and do them.”
God said, “I am the LORD who makes you holy.”
If a man has sexual relations with another man’s wife, he commits adultery.
If a man commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, he breaks God’s law.
God commands that both the man and the woman who commit adultery must be put to death.
God holds both the adulterer and the adulteress guilty.
passages.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִנְאַף֙ אֶת־ אֵ֣שֶׁת אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִנְאַ֖ף אֶת־ אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֑הוּ מֽוֹת־ יוּמַ֥ת הַנֹּאֵ֖ף וְהַנֹּאָֽפֶת׃

passages.text: If a man lies with his father’s wife, he has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
passages.sermon:
This law comes from God’s commands to Israel.
God gave these commands to Moses.
God told the people how to live holy lives.
If a man lies with his father’s wife, he commits a grave sin.
He has uncovered his father’s nakedness.
This act is a serious offense.
Both the man and his father’s wife must be put to death.
They are both guilty.
Their blood is upon them.
passages.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־ אֵ֣שֶׁת אָבִ֔יו עֶרְוַ֥ת אָבִ֖יו גִּלָּ֑ה מֽוֹת־ יוּמְת֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃

passages.text: If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both must surely be put to death. They have acted perversely; their blood is upon them.
passages.sermon:
A man may lie with his daughter-in-law.
This act is a grave sin.
Both the man and the daughter-in-law must be put to death.
They have acted perversely.
They bear the guilt for their actions.
passages.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־ כַּלָּת֔וֹ מ֥וֹת יוּמְת֖וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֑ם תֶּ֥בֶל עָשׂ֖וּ דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃

passages.text: If a man lies with a man as with a woman, they have both committed an abomination. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel through Moses.
God commanded the people to avoid certain acts.
If a man lies with another man as he would with a woman, both men have done a forbidden act.
God calls this act an abomination.
Both men must be put to death.
They are responsible for their own deaths.
passages.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֤ב אֶת־ זָכָר֙ מִשְׁכְּבֵ֣י אִשָּׁ֔ה תּוֹעֵבָ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֑ם מ֥וֹת יוּמָ֖תוּ דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃

passages.text: If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is depraved. Both he and they must be burned in the fire, so that there will be no depravity among you.
passages.sermon:
A man who marries a woman and also marries her mother acts in a depraved way.
This act is depravity.
You must burn the man and both women in the fire.
You must do this so that depravity will not exist among you.
passages.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִקַּ֧ח אֶת־ אִשָּׁ֛ה וְאֶת־ אִמָּ֖הּ זִמָּ֣ה הִ֑וא בָּאֵ֞שׁ יִשְׂרְפ֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ וְאֶתְהֶ֔ן וְלֹא־ תִהְיֶ֥ה זִמָּ֖ה בְּתוֹכְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: If a man lies carnally with an animal, he must be put to death. And you are also to kill the animal.
passages.sermon: A man who has sexual relations with an animal commits a grave sin.\r\nYou must put the man to death.\r\nYou must also kill the animal.
passages.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֧ן שְׁכָבְתּ֛וֹ בִּבְהֵמָ֖ה מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑ת וְאֶת־ הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה תַּהֲרֹֽגוּ׃

passages.text: If a woman approaches any animal to mate with it, you must kill both the woman and the animal. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
passages.sermon:
A woman must not approach any animal to mate with it.
If a woman does this, you must kill the woman and the animal.
You must put both the woman and the animal to death.
They are responsible for their own blood.
passages.original: וְאִשָּׁ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּקְרַ֤ב אֶל־ כָּל־ בְּהֵמָה֙ לְרִבְעָ֣ה אֹתָ֔הּ וְהָרַגְתָּ֥ אֶת־ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה וְאֶת־ הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה מ֥וֹת יוּמָ֖תוּ דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃

passages.text: If a man marries his sister, whether the daughter of his father or of his mother, and they have sexual relations, it is a disgrace. They must be cut off in the sight of their people. He has uncovered the nakedness of his sister; he shall bear his iniquity.
passages.sermon:
A man may have a sister.
She may be the daughter of his father.
She may be the daughter of his mother.
If this man marries his sister, it is wrong.
If this man has sexual relations with his sister, it is a disgrace.
Both the man and his sister have seen each other’s nakedness.
The people must cut them off from their community.
The man has uncovered his sister’s nakedness.
He will bear his guilt.
passages.original: וְאִ֣ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יִקַּ֣ח אֶת־ אֲחֹת֡וֹ בַּת־ אָבִ֣יו א֣וֹ בַת־ אִ֠מּוֹ וְרָאָ֨ה אֶת־ עֶרְוָתָ֜הּ וְהִֽיא־ תִרְאֶ֤ה אֶת־ עֶרְוָתוֹ֙ חֶ֣סֶד ה֔וּא וְנִ֨כְרְת֔וּ לְעֵינֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י עַמָּ֑ם עֶרְוַ֧ת אֲחֹת֛וֹ גִּלָּ֖ה עֲוֺנ֥וֹ יִשָּֽׂא׃

passages.text: If a man lies with a menstruating woman and has sexual relations with her, he has exposed the source of her flow, and she has uncovered the source of her blood. Both of them must be cut off from among their people.
passages.sermon:
A man may lie with a woman.
The woman may be menstruating.
If the man has sexual relations with her during her menstruation, he exposes the source of her flow.
The woman also uncovers the source of her blood.
Both the man and the woman have done this act.
They must both be cut off from among their people.
passages.original: וְ֠אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אֶת־ אִשָּׁ֜ה דָּוָ֗ה וְגִלָּ֤ה אֶת־ עֶרְוָתָהּ֙ אֶת־ מְקֹרָ֣הּ הֶֽעֱרָ֔ה וְהִ֕יא גִּלְּתָ֖ה אֶת־ מְק֣וֹר דָּמֶ֑יהָ וְנִכְרְת֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽם׃

passages.text: You must not have sexual relations with the sister of your mother or your father, for it is exposing one’s own kin; both shall bear their iniquity.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel.
God forbids sexual relations with close relatives.
A person must not have sexual relations with his mother’s sister.
A person must not have sexual relations with his father’s sister.
These women are close kin.
Such acts expose one’s own family.
Both people who do this will bear their guilt.
passages.original: וְעֶרְוַ֨ת אֲח֧וֹת אִמְּךָ֛ וַאֲח֥וֹת אָבִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה כִּ֧י אֶת־ שְׁאֵר֛וֹ הֶעֱרָ֖ה עֲוֺנָ֥ם יִשָּֽׂאוּ׃

passages.text: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered the nakedness of his uncle. They will bear their sin; they shall die childless.
passages.sermon:
A man may lie with his uncle’s wife.
He has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness.
Both the man and the woman have sinned.
They will bear their sin.
They will die without children.
passages.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־ דֹּ֣דָת֔וֹ עֶרְוַ֥ת דֹּד֖וֹ גִּלָּ֑ה חֶטְאָ֥ם יִשָּׂ֖אוּ עֲרִירִ֥ים יָמֻֽתוּ׃

passages.text: If a man marries his brother’s wife, it is an act of impurity. He has uncovered the nakedness of his brother; they shall be childless.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel.
God set Israel apart from other nations.
God commanded Israel to obey His statutes and ordinances.

If a man marries his brother’s wife, he commits an act of impurity.
He uncovers the nakedness of his brother.
They will have no children.
passages.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִקַּ֛ח אֶת־ אֵ֥שֶׁת אָחִ֖יו נִדָּ֣ה הִ֑וא עֶרְוַ֥ת אָחִ֛יו גִּלָּ֖ה עֲרִירִ֥ים יִהְיֽוּ׃

passages.text: You are therefore to keep all My statutes and ordinances, so that the land where I am bringing you to live will not vomit you out.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God gives them statutes and ordinances.
God commands them to keep all His statutes.
God commands them to keep all His ordinances.
God commands them to do all these things.
God is bringing them into a land.
God is bringing them there to live in that land.
If they obey, the land will not reject them.
If they obey, the land will not expel them.
passages.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֶת־ כָּל־ חֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹא־ תָקִ֤יא אֶתְכֶם֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֜י מֵבִ֥יא אֶתְכֶ֛ם שָׁ֖מָּה לָשֶׁ֥בֶת בָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: You must not follow the statutes of the nations I am driving out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God said, “I am driving out other nations from before you.
Do not follow the rules and customs of these nations.
These nations did all these wrong things.
I hated what they did.
I rejected them because of their actions.”
passages.original: וְלֹ֤א תֵֽלְכוּ֙ בְּחֻקֹּ֣ת הַגּ֔וֹי אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֥י מְשַׁלֵּ֖חַ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֤י אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ עָשׂ֔וּ וָאָקֻ֖ץ בָּֽם׃

passages.text: But I have told you that you will inherit their land, since I will give it to you as an inheritance—a land flowing with milk and honey. I am the LORD your God, who has set you apart from the peoples.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God said, “You will inherit the land of the nations before you.
I will give you this land to possess.
This land flows with milk and honey.
I am the LORD your God.
I have set you apart from all other peoples.”
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֣ר לָכֶ֗ם אַתֶּם֮ תִּֽירְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־ אַדְמָתָם֒ וַאֲנִ֞י אֶתְּנֶ֤נָּה לָכֶם֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֹתָ֔הּ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָ֑שׁ אֲנִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ הִבְדַּ֥לְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִן־ הָֽעַמִּֽים׃

passages.text: You are therefore to distinguish between clean and unclean animals and birds. Do not become contaminated by any animal or bird, or by anything that crawls on the ground; I have set these apart as unclean for you.
passages.sermon:
God commands the Israelites to be different from other nations.
God tells the Israelites to separate clean animals from unclean animals.
God tells the Israelites to separate clean birds from unclean birds.
Do not make yourselves unclean by touching any animal that is unclean.
Do not make yourselves unclean by touching any bird that is unclean.
Do not make yourselves unclean by touching anything that crawls on the ground and is unclean.
God has set these animals, birds, and crawling things apart as unclean for the Israelites.
God wants the Israelites to avoid what is unclean.
passages.original: וְהִבְדַּלְתֶּ֞ם בֵּֽין־ הַבְּהֵמָ֤ה הַטְּהֹרָה֙ לַטְּמֵאָ֔ה וּבֵין־ הָע֥וֹף הַטָּמֵ֖א לַטָּהֹ֑ר וְלֹֽא־ תְשַׁקְּצ֨וּ אֶת־ נַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶ֜ם בַּבְּהֵמָ֣ה וּבָע֗וֹף וּבְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּרְמֹ֣שׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ הִבְדַּ֥לְתִּי לָכֶ֖ם לְטַמֵּֽא׃

passages.text: You are to be holy to Me because I, the LORD, am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be My own.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD is holy.
The LORD has set you apart from all other nations.
You belong to the LORD.
You must be holy to the LORD.
passages.original: וִהְיִ֤יתֶם לִי֙ קְדֹשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י קָד֖וֹשׁ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וָאַבְדִּ֥ל אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִן־ הָֽעַמִּ֖ים לִהְי֥וֹת לִֽי׃

passages.text: A man or a woman who is a medium or spiritist must surely be put to death. They shall be stoned; their blood is upon them.’ ”
passages.sermon:
A man or a woman may become a medium or a spiritist.
A medium or a spiritist tries to contact spirits or the dead.
God commands that a medium or a spiritist must be put to death.
The people must stone them with stones.
They are responsible for their own death.
passages.original: וְאִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ־ אִשָּׁ֗ה כִּֽי־ יִהְיֶ֨ה בָהֶ֥ם א֛וֹב א֥וֹ יִדְּעֹנִ֖י מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑תוּ בָּאֶ֛בֶן יִרְגְּמ֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃פ
